title: 第6章天骄？武道境界
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
上中二字，如同一块巨石砸入平静的湖面。

    轰！

    全场哗然！

    那些被淘汰的、正在等候的，甚至是在演武场另一侧操练的老镖师们，全都停下了手中的动作，齐刷刷地投来了震惊且羡慕的目光。

    “什么？上中根骨？”

    “天哪！我们雷云县已经多少年没出过上中根骨的天才了？”

    “这小子要一步登天了！只要不中途夭折，未来至少是一位八品武者！”

    主位之上，一直稳如泰山的秦虎豁地一下站了起来，他蒲扇般的大手因为太过用力，将身前的红木桌案捏得咯吱作响，脸上满是毫不掩饰的狂喜。

    上中根骨！

    按照风云镖局的根骨测试，根骨分为下下一直到上上九个品阶。

    下下就代表着勉强有资格迈入武道。

    而中下开始就有机会迈入九品！

    至于上等根骨开始，更是有望八品！

    一个上中根骨的苗子……未来成就八品的可能性更是极高。

    甚至，即便是雷云县最为顶尖的半步七品，都有可能涉足！

    这等麒麟儿，是他风云镖局的未来！

    在所有目光的焦点处，那名叫林枫的少年，身材挺拔，面容俊朗。

    此刻，他微微昂着下巴，嘴角噙着一抹抑制不住的笑意，尽情享受着这万众瞩目的感觉。那双明亮的眼眸中，透着一股与生俱来的桀骜与自负。

    角落里，陈安看着这几乎要沸腾的场面，眼神之中闪过了一丝丝的好奇之色。

    “上中根骨么？”

    说着，陈安看向了系统面板。

    【根骨：27】

    “上中……”他心里嘀咕了一句，“那我这二十七点，算什么什么层次的根骨？”

    陈安有些好奇，毕竟陈安对于武道的认知还是太少了，陈安唯一能够感觉到的，便是随着根骨点数的提升，自己在修行太极桩的时候，效率也是越来越高的。

    考核很快就在林枫带来的巨大冲击中结束了，总计四十五人入选，其中四十三个趟子手，一个根骨中下的，被王铁破格收为学徒。

    而林枫，则是唯一一个上中。
content_en:
The words "Shang Zhong" are like a huge stone smashing into a calm lake.

    boom!

    The whole place was in an uproar!

    Those who had been eliminated, those who were waiting, and even the old escorts who were practicing on the other side of the martial arts arena, all stopped what they were doing, and all cast shocked and envious glances.

    "What? Upper middle root bone?"

    "Oh my god! How many years has it been since we in Leiyun County had a genius with upper and middle bones?"

    "This kid is going to reach the sky in one step! As long as he doesn't die on the way, he will be at least an eighth-level warrior in the future!"

    On the throne, Qin Hu, who had always been as steady as a mountain, suddenly stood up. His big palm-like hands squeezed the mahogany table in front of him with too much force, and his face was full of undisguised ecstasy.

    Upper middle root bone!

    According to Fengyun Escort's root bone test, the root bones are divided into nine levels from lower to upper.

    Being below means barely qualified to enter the martial arts.

    And starting from the middle or lower level, you have the opportunity to enter the ninth level!

    As for the superior root bones, it is even expected to be at the eighth level!

    A seedling with an upper middle level of bones... has a very high possibility of reaching the eighth level in the future.

    In fact, even the top half-step seventh-level players in Leiyun County may get involved!

    This Qilin'er is the future of his Fengyun Escort Agency!

    At the focus of all eyes, the young man named Lin Feng was tall and tall with a handsome face.

    At this moment, he raised his chin slightly, with an uncontrollable smile on his lips, enjoying the feeling of being in the spotlight. There was an innate sense of unruly and conceitedness in those bright eyes.

    In the corner, Chen An looked at the almost boiling scene, with a trace of curiosity flashing in his eyes.

    "The upper middle bone?"

    With that said, Chen An looked at the system panel.

    【Root bone: 27】

    "Shangzhong..." He muttered in his heart, "Then my twenty-seven points, what kind of foundation do I have?"

    Chen An was a little curious. After all, Chen An still knew too little about martial arts. The only thing Chen An could feel was that as his root bone points increased, he became more and more efficient when practicing Tai Chi.

    The assessment soon ended with a huge shock brought by Lin Feng. A total of forty-five people were selected, of which forty-three were the runners, one with average bones and a low-level bones, who was accepted as an apprentice by Wang Tie.

    Lin Feng, on the other hand, was the only one in the upper middle school.
